contextImport.title: Import from AI conversations
contextImport.subtitle: My story from another AI
contextImport.prepareTitle: Continue with what another AI knows about me
contextImport.prepareBody: Copy the prompt below and send it to the AI you have been talking with. The same prompt works with any AI. Bring back its response and choose what to add.
contextImport.privacy: While you review, your input stays on this device. Only what you select will be saved.
contextImport.copyFailed: Could not copy the prompt. Please try again.
contextImport.inputBody: Paste the JSON response from the AI or choose its profile-context.json file. You can review the contents before saving.
contextImport.pastePlaceholder: Paste the copied JSON response here
contextImport.invalidSize: This file is too large. Split it into files of 256KB or less.
contextImport.invalidSyntax: We could not read the response. Check that you copied the complete JSON.
contextImport.invalidContract: This response does not match the import format. Ask the AI to prepare it again using the copied prompt.
contextImport.invalidReferences: We could not match the contents to their sources. Ask the AI to prepare the response again using the same prompt.
contextImport.empty: There is nothing to import. Try again with an AI that has conversations about you.
contextImport.sourceReported: Another AI prepared these statements and sources. Please check that they are accurate.
contextImport.selectionScope: Applies to all categories, including hidden items. Confirm AI interpretations and items with an unclear basis first.
contextImport.confirmInference: I checked that this describes me
contextImport.needsConfirmation: Check this statement before selecting it
contextImport.confirmBody: Your selected statements and linked sources will be added to your records. Only profile fields you choose to change below will be updated.
contextImport.doneBody: {{count}} details were added to your records.
contextImport.historyEmpty: You have not imported any stories yet
contextImport.historyError: Could not load your import history.
contextImport.failed: We could not confirm the result. Please retry with the same contents.
contextImport.profileConflict: Your profile changed elsewhere. Review the latest information before saving again.
contextImport.profileChangesHint: Your existing information is selected first. Choose to change only the fields you want to update, then enter their new values.
contextImport.saveConsent: I agree to save my selected statements and sources to my records and apply my selected profile changes.
contextImport.pendingExitBody: Your import may already be saved. Check the import history for the result. A recent request may take a moment to appear.
contextImport.discardBody: Contents and selections you have not applied will not be saved.
contextImport.withdrawConfirmBody: Records added by this import will be deleted. Your basic profile will return to its previous state only if it has not changed since and that state can safely be restored.
contextImport.withdrawalKeptProfile: Your current profile was kept because it changed later or its previous state could not be restored.
contextImport.withdrawalFailed: Could not undo this import. Please try again.
